title: Thirty second polling is a large share of a five minute campaign
foundBy: session agent, while reading the member trajectories of a `make demo` run
details:
`cs-campaign-member wait` checks for a reply every `pollSeconds`, and the default is 30. This campaign has about four handoffs, so polling adds up to two minutes. That is small against a two hour campaign. Here it is about as long as the developer's whole job.

The profile accepts a campaign-wide `policy.pollSeconds`. A value of 10 has not been tried, and the cost in ssh probes across three members has not been measured.
